title: Implement and prove the approved typography foundation
objective: Turn DEC-TYPE-001 into a licensed, packaged, responsive, cross-channel typography system without reopening the approved Geist display and tuned Inter body/UI direction.

included: font provenance, licence records, and repository packaging
semantic typography roles and generated tokens
desktop and mobile scales, line heights, tracking, line length, truncation, and fallbacks
marketing, commerce, email, document, and dense-UI fixtures
excluded: reopening the Geist plus tuned Inter pairing without new evidence

acceptance: canonical source, tokens, guidance, fixtures, and tests agree
font files have recorded provenance and allowed distribution
supported desktop and mobile fixtures pass without overflow
review plate isolates typography judgment with realistic content
approved references and failure cases are visible
human can approve, request edits, or reject with a recorded note

verification.passCondition: tokens and task records validate against their schemas
fixtures pass at 320px, 375px, tablet, desktop, and wide desktop with realistic copy
zoom, reflow, legibility, contrast, and fallback behavior meet the foundation contract
Olli approves the complete type proof

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does this implementation make Geist display and tuned Inter body/UI feel recognisably Mez and remain excellent across the required channels and responsive states?

stopConditions: font licence or redistribution authority cannot be established
realistic content or responsive fixtures fail
implementation would require silently replacing the approved type direction
notes: Instrument Serif remains contextual only and IBM Plex Mono remains restricted to technical content unless a new decision changes that scope.
